evaluations.prompt: I captured a torch.profiler trace of a training step and one custom op looks slow. Here is trace.json -- work out where the time actually goes.
expected_behavior: Run scripts/torch_trace_scope_summary.py against the trace instead of guessing from the operator name.
Separate Python scope time, ATen/CPU time, GPU kernel time, runtime API overhead and memory copies.
Attribute GPU kernels through HIP/CUDA runtime correlation values rather than wall-clock overlap alone.
Classify the bottleneck as host/runtime, memory movement, algorithmic, compute, or fallback before proposing fixes.

evaluations.prompt: A Triton kernel dominates the timeline in this Perfetto trace. Map it back to the source and tell me what to change.
expected_behavior: Trace the hot scope from Python wrapper through the extension binding to the kernel.
Rank proposals by measured impact and keep facts separate from inferences.

evaluations.prompt: Break down this profiler JSON by model submodule so I can see which block is worth optimizing first.
Summarize this trace into a before/after optimization report. I do not have the target GPU on this machine.
expected_behavior: Derive before numbers from the trace and label after numbers as targets or estimates.
State that the current machine cannot reproduce the measurement and list the commands to rerun on the real environment.
unexpected_behavior: Presents projected after numbers as measured results.

evaluations.prompt: Write a fused attention operator for HCU and get it building against DTK.
Run this model on the node and benchmark end-to-end throughput at batch size 64.
